topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides introductory framing and sets expectations for the lecture.

topics.label: Fundamentals and Core Architecture of the Complement System
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the fundamental principles of complement, including its major functions, naming conventions, and the pivotal role of C3.

topics.label: Pathways of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the alternative, lectin, and classical pathways recognize targets and converge to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Downstream Effector Mechanisms of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the terminal effector outcomes generated by complement activation to eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical Manifestations of Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the specific medical consequences and disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in different complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens counteract and evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides closing remarks and previews the subject of the next lecture.
